reply_text:
I answered Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I can't confirm the 23 May date, so I'm treating it as an unverified tip, not a deadline.

- **Nothing to check it against:** there are no Thornbury Cloth Co. files on the share, and #central-team (the channel Pree posted in) has never mentioned the account.
- **The date looks off:** it's 14 October now, so 23 May would mean next May. Either the date was misheard or it's for a later order form.

I suggested she get the date from her Thornbury contact in writing before anyone plans around it. I also offered to draft an internal note asking the account owner to confirm it. Nobody has been contacted and nothing has been recorded anywhere.
